Houses.metaTitle: House design and build in Islamabad | 5 marla, 10 marla, 1 kanal
Houses.metaDescription: Architect in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for 5 marla, 10 marla, and 1 kanal houses. Gulberg Greens, DHA, Park View, PGSHF, CDA sectors. Design, approvals, and construction in one studio.
Houses.lede: Most of our work is the plot people actually own: 5 marla, 10 marla, 1 kanal, in Islamabad and Rawalpindi. One contract for architecture and construction. The family can read this page in Urdu; the person abroad can read it in English.
Houses.plot5Body: On five marla every foot counts. The house is often two or three floors. Parents and children under one roof. We work inside coverage, height, and the society’s rules - kitchen, rooms, a stair that does not eat the plot, a bit of open sky where the bylaws allow it.
Houses.plot10Body: Ten marla is the size we draw most. A family house: sitting, kitchen, a parents’ floor, parking, sometimes a courtyard. PGSHF, Gulberg Greens, Park View, DHA - the card always says society and marla. If you searched “10 marla house design” or “Gulberg Greens architect,” this is that work.
Houses.plot1Body: One kanal opens the plan: more garden, more front, modern cream-and-stone or classical limestone and arches - we have both. DHA and the larger societies. We build this size of house. We do not advertise farmhouses we have not built.
Houses.otherBody: Smaller, larger, a shop below and a house above, a CDA sector that is only now opening - send size, society, and which authority. We will say if it is ours.
Houses.whereBody: Twin cities first: DHA, Gulberg Greens, Park View City, PGSHF, Bahria, and CDA sectors as they open. We have also drawn and finished houses and rooms in Mansehra, Attock, and other cities in the work.

Approvals.metaDescription: Honest notes on who stamps Form A-2 in Islamabad and Rawalpindi. The firm is not “CDA-approved.” What you bring: plot size, society, allotment or possession, which authority.
Approvals.title: Approvals. Short, and honest.
Approvals.lede: In Islamabad you cannot lawfully submit your own house drawings. A licensed architect and a licensed engineer stamp Form A-2 - people, with names and numbers, enlisted with the authority that governs the plot. FluX is not “CDA-approved” as a firm. Postal address is not the authority.
Approvals.authCdaBody: CDA. Drawings on Form A-1 (owner) and Form A-2 (architect + engineer). The architect signs every sheet. Supervision through completion; Form B-1 / B-2 and as-built drawings for the completion certificate.
Approvals.authDhaBody: DHA’s own affiliate list for architects, structural and MEP engineers.
Approvals.authSocPlace: Societies (Gulberg, Park View, Bahria, PGSHF, others)
Approvals.authSocBody: Society plus, often, CDA or RDA underneath. Name the society; we will say who actually stamps.
Approvals.weDoBody: Drawings that can be submitted. Named licensed people stamp Form A-2. Licence numbers and enlistment sit on this page only when they are real - we will not badge a blank.
Approvals.bring1: Plot size (5 marla / 10 marla / 1 kanal / other)
Approvals.bring4: Which authority you believe governs the plot (CDA, RDA, DHA, cantonment, society)
Approvals.packNote: CDA’s public pack still includes scrutiny fee and copies of plans; we will list the current set when we open the file. We do not promise a number of weeks.
Approvals.close: We do not sell a bylaw encyclopaedia. We tell you, for this plot, who stamps and what is missing.

Faq.metaTitle: FAQ | Building a house in Islamabad and Rawalpindi
Faq.metaDescription: Plot sizes, Form A-2, CGI versus site, and building from abroad. First-hand answers from FluX Design and Construction.
Faq.title: Questions people ask.
Faq.lede: The questions families type into Google, and into agents, about a house in Islamabad or Rawalpindi. Short answers, then the page that holds the work.
Faq.costQ: How much does it cost to build a 5 marla, 10 marla, or 1 kanal house in Islamabad in 2026?
Faq.costA1: There is no honest round number on WhatsApp. Plot size, covered area, grey structure versus finishing versus turnkey, and the society all change the figure.
Faq.costA2: Ask for a BOQ - a bill of quantities - not a slogan price. Send the plot size and society, or WhatsApp the plot for a first look.
Faq.greyQ: What is included in grey structure, finishing, and turnkey?
Faq.greyA1: Grey structure is the frame, the slab, the brick. Finishing is floors, kitchens, wet areas, paint - the drawings already know the kitchen and the bath. Turnkey is one contract from drawing to keys, still not a blank cheque: plot, coverage, and specification sit in the BOQ.
Faq.greyA2: Read the three scopes on Build. We stay on after grey if you want us to; we do not pretend a chat price is a contract.
Faq.marlaQ: Is “10 marla” CDA 35×70, or 225 square feet to the marla?
Faq.marlaA1: It depends on the society. CDA’s 10 marla is often 35 by 70 feet. Some societies sell a smaller marla. We design the plot you actually own, not a poster size.
Faq.marlaA2: Write the size as your papers say it, and the society name. Houses is organised by 5 marla, 10 marla, and 1 kanal because that is what people search and what they own.
Faq.sketchQ: Can I sketch my plot before we talk?
Faq.sketchA1: Yes. Stamp rooms on a 5 marla, 10 marla, or 1 kanal rectangle. It is a family conversation, not a CDA or DHA drawing.
Faq.sketchA2: Download the pack when you are ready. We use it as a first brief, then WhatsApp Ar. Adnan and Engr. Umair.
Faq.boqQ: What is a BOQ, and why is a WhatsApp quote not a contract?
Faq.boqA1: A BOQ lists the work and the quantities. That is the document a price can sit on. A round number in chat is not.
Faq.boqA2: We will not pretend otherwise. Send the plot; we will say what has to be measured.
Faq.cdaSelfQ: Can I submit my own house drawings to CDA?
Faq.cdaSelfA1: In Islamabad you cannot lawfully submit your own house drawings. A licensed architect and a licensed engineer stamp Form A-2 - people, with names and numbers, enlisted with the authority that governs the plot.
Faq.cdaSelfA2: FluX is not “CDA-approved” as a firm. Postal address is not the authority. The honest version is on Approvals.
Faq.formsQ: What is Form A-1, A-2, B-1, and B-2?
Faq.formsA1: Under CDA, Form A-1 is the owner. Form A-2 is the architect and the engineer; the architect signs every sheet. Supervision runs through completion. Form B-1 / B-2 and as-built drawings go with the completion certificate.
Faq.formsA2: DHA, RDA, cantonment, and societies have their own lists. Name the society; we will say who actually stamps.
Faq.licensedQ: Who must be PCATP / PEC / CDA-enlisted? Is FluX licensed?
Faq.licensedA1: The people who stamp, not a slogan on the door. Ar. Adnan Ejaz is the designer architect. Engr. Umair Ejaz is the civil engineer. Licence numbers and enlistment sit on Studio only when they are real - we will not badge a blank.
Faq.licensedA2: Bring plot size, society, allotment or possession, CNIC, and which authority you believe governs the plot.
Faq.timingQ: How long does CDA, DHA, RDA, or a society take?
Faq.timingA1: We do not promise a number of weeks. It depends on the authority and on whether the file is complete.
Faq.timingA2: We tell you, for this plot, who stamps and what is missing. We do not sell a bylaw encyclopaedia.
Faq.papersA1: Plot size (5 marla / 10 marla / 1 kanal / other). Society or sector. Allotment and / or possession. The authority you believe governs the plot (CDA, RDA, DHA, cantonment, society). CNIC of the owner. Any drawings already made.
Faq.papersA2: CDA’s public pack still includes a scrutiny fee and copies of plans; we will list the current set when we open the file.
Faq.familyQ: How do you design a 5 marla, 10 marla, or 1 kanal house for a joint family?
Faq.familyA1: Five marla: every foot counts, often two or three floors, parents and children under one roof, a stair that does not eat the plot. Ten marla is the size we draw most - sitting, kitchen, a parents’ floor, parking, sometimes a courtyard. One kanal opens the plan: more garden, more front, modern or classical. We have both. We do not advertise farmhouses we have not built.
Faq.familyA2: PGSHF, Park View City, DHA III, Gulberg Greens - the card always says society and marla. See Houses and Work.
Faq.cgiA1: CGI is a render, not a photograph. We label it CGI. On PGSHF, DHA III, and Gulberg Green we show the render next to the pour so you can judge.
Faq.cgiA2: We do not grade a slab to look like a picture. Compare the pairs on Build and on the case studies in Work.
Faq.reportQ: How do you report from site? Is there a live camera?
Faq.reportA1: Weekly photographs on WhatsApp. Named engineer on the job. We do not promise a live camera feed.
Faq.reportA2: If you are abroad, the weekly photos still go out. Build explains grey, finishing, and turnkey.
Faq.whereQ: Do you work as an architect in Islamabad and Rawalpindi - PGSHF, DHA, Gulberg Greens?
Faq.whereA1: The office is 1 Adiyala Rd, Rawalpindi. The work is Islamabad and Rawalpindi first: PGSHF, Park View City, DHA III, Gulberg Greens, Bahria, and CDA sectors as they open. We have also drawn and finished rooms in Mansehra and Attock.
Faq.whereA2: New CDA sectors - send the society, we will say if it is ours. Contact has the map pin. Work has the named plots.
Faq.overseasQ: Can we build a house from Dubai, the UK, or Canada?
Faq.overseasA1: Yes. WhatsApp first. We reply within one working day (PKT). Write your city and we will call at a time that works for you - usually your evening.
Faq.overseasA2: Weekly site photos once work starts. Milestone pay is bank, not a website checkout. Same number as on Contact: +92 339 0028224.
Faq.pickQ: How do I pick an architect versus a contractor versus design-build?
Faq.pickA1: FluX is one studio for architecture, interiors, and construction - drawings that can be approved, and a site that matches them. You are not coordinating three WhatsApp groups unless you choose to.
Faq.pickA2: If you only need the house drawn, or only interiors, say so. Houses, Interiors, and Build are separate pages so the job stays clear.

Privacy.metaDescription: How FluX Design and Construction handles enquiries, WhatsApp, and the contact form.
Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.lede: How this site uses what you send us. Company name and address match the domain when they are confirmed.
Privacy.whoBody: This site is {domain}, operated by {legal} (public name: {publicName}). Office: {address}.
Privacy.whoFallback: {publicName}, {cities}. Office: {address}. A registered legal name will appear here when it is confirmed.
Privacy.collectBody: From the form: name, WhatsApp number, plot size, society, service, the city you are writing from, and your message. The form emails that enquiry to the studio. From WhatsApp or a call: whatever you send us about the plot. We do not run a client portal or a marketing pixel wall on this site in v1.
Privacy.useBody: To answer the enquiry, to look at the plot, and to keep a record of what was agreed. We do not sell your number. WhatsApp is Meta’s product; their terms apply to that chat.
Privacy.longBody: Enquiry notes until the job is declined or, if we build, for as long as the drawings and the site file are needed - including approvals. Ask us to delete a chat that did not become a job and we will, except where the law says keep it.
Privacy.sketchBody: If you download a sketch pack we store the sketch JSON (rooms on the plot), a sketch id, your name, WhatsApp number, optional email, society or sector, the city you are writing from, the page language, and the time. We use it to send the pack and to talk to you about design-build. We do not sell leads. WhatsApp follow-up only if you tick the box. To stop, reply STOP or “please don’t message” - we honour it. Sketch links use unguessable ids; they are not a public gallery. A sketch that did not become a job is kept for up to 24 months, then deleted, unless the law says keep it.
Privacy.contactFallback: Privacy questions: use the contact form.
Privacy.photoPlane: The privacy notice will sit here.
